fact: The ministry reported 2023 results against its indicators (fixed broadband penetration 5% against a 3% forecast; 4G population coverage 91% against 63%) and presented a 2025 budget of 60,780,440,826 FCFA, of which 35.3 billion FCFA for the universal service programme.
title: Assemblée Nationale de Côte d'Ivoire, Abidjan, le 20 novembre 2024 (Projet de budget 2025)
publisher: Ministère de la Transition Numérique et de la Digitalisation
